blocks.title: No. 36: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Beethoven Sonata DSD 256 Collage
blocks.description: A cinematic historical-to-futuristic music collage visualizing Beethoven's sonata performance transformed by modern DSD 256 audio.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic widescreen digital collage about Beethoven's Violin Sonata Op. 96 being rediscovered through modern high-resolution audio, blending a 19th-century Viennese salon performance with a futuristic DSD listening studio.
Canvas: 16:9 horizontal composition, dark dramatic chiaroscuro, ultra-detailed, painterly realism mixed with cybernetic audio visualization. The image should read left-to-right as a transformation from old classical performance to modern digital sound.
Layout: Split the scene into two connected halves with no hard border. Left half is a warm amber-brown historical oil-painting scene inside an ornate Viennese salon. Right half is a cool blue-black futuristic audiophile studio. A single horizontal audio waveform runs across the entire center of the image, starting as gold on the historical side and shifting into white, cyan, orange, magenta, and blue on the digital side.
Historical left side: Show exactly 2 main historical men in the foreground: 1 famous violinist in black formal 19th-century clothing playing a violin with a languid, tired expression, and 1 intense curly-haired Beethoven-like composer standing behind him, watching sternly. Add a small salon audience in the background, candlelit chandeliers, gilded walls, dark framed paintings, and aristocratic spectators. In the lower center-left foreground, include several large aged sheet-music pages with handwritten notation, tilted toward the viewer. Add a small monochrome ghostly orchestra scene in the lower-left corner as a memory-like vignette.
Modern right side: Show exactly 1 sleek black rectangular digital audio converter on a table, labeled "DSD 256" on its front panel, with a small round knob on the right. Place exactly 1 large black studio monitor speaker on the far right. Behind and around the device, create glowing cyan holographic equalizer bars, translucent circuit-like panels, soundwave diagrams, and floating fragments of musical notation. Below the device, show a vivid red-orange waveform falling downward like molten sound, merging into a glowing blue and magenta holographic architectural concert hall made of music staves and light.
Visual style: Hyper-detailed, moody, cinematic lighting, baroque oil-painting texture on the left, glossy high-tech cyber-audio rendering on the right, dense layered transparency, gold dust and smoky particles, deep blacks, amber candlelight, electric cyan and magenta neon. Make the transition feel emotional and profound, as if the true meaning of {argument name="musical work" default="Beethoven Violin Sonata Op. 96"} is revealed by {argument name="audio format" default="DSD 256"} in {argument name="recording year" default="2025"}.
Text constraints: The only readable device text should be "DSD 256". Do not add captions, titles, logos, watermarks, or extra typography.
blocks.author: Juan José Arango E.

blocks.title: No. 37: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Dunhuang Rhythms Exhibition Poster
blocks.description: Creates a dense archival museum poster blending Dunhuang mural fragments, Chinese calligraphy, exhibition details, and editorial collage typography.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a dense editorial cultural-exhibition poster about {argument name="exhibition title" default="Dunhuang Rhythms"}, combining Dunhuang mural fragments, music-and-dance archive typography, and layered museum ephemera.
Canvas: Tall vertical poster, approximately 2:3 ratio, aged warm beige rice-paper background with visible grain, stains, torn edges, faded ink, and pasted-collage seams. Overall mood is scholarly, archaeological, and highly designed, with intentional clutter but a strong grid.
Layout: Use an asymmetric high-density collage. On the far left, place four enormous stacked black Chinese calligraphy characters reading 「壁上乐舞」, occupying nearly the full height, distressed and ink-textured. Beside the large characters, add a narrow vertical Chinese subtitle reading 「敦煌壁画中的乐舞与文明」. At the top center-left, add a small bilingual series label: 「丝路映像 系列展」 with “Silk Road Imaging Series” underneath. At the top right, place the main English title in elegant serif capitals: “DUNHUANG RHYTHMS”, with the smaller subtitle “Fragments of Murals and Music” below.
Main imagery: Use exactly 6 visible mural/image fragments, all in faded Dunhuang cave-painting colors of turquoise, cinnabar red, ochre, black, and parchment beige: 1) a large upper-right flying apsara musician fragment with flowing ribbons crossing diagonally; 2) a lower-left torn fragment showing three mural musicians or dancers; 3) a mid-right small rectangular fragment of a standing dancer; 4) a mid-lower ornate floral scroll pattern fragment; 5) a large bottom-right close-up of a female bodhisattva or apsara face with jewelry and flowing ribbons; 6) a right-edge partial vertical mural strip cropped off the page. Make the fragments look like scanned ancient wall paintings with cracks, missing plaster, chipped edges, and uneven opacity.
Information blocks: Add many thin vertical Chinese text columns like museum notes and archival captions around the collage, especially along the far left margin, middle columns, and lower center. Include exactly 4 primary info panels: 1) a right-side date and venue panel with “2026 09.05 SAT / 2027 01.16 SUN”, Chinese venue text, and “Hexi Culture Center Shanghai”; 2) a lower-left educational panel listing “Instruments” and “Dance Poses” with a small line drawing of an instrument; 3) a bottom-left organizer/credits panel with Host, Co-operation, and Visual Design lines; 4) a lower-right cave caption panel reading “Cave 285, South Wall Music and Dance Scene (detail)” with Chinese above it.
Typography and style: Mix oversized rough black Chinese brush type, refined Western serif uppercase, small Chinese Song/Ming-style vertical text, and tiny English museum captions. Use black, dark brown, muted red stamp ink, and occasional faded grid marks. Add small red seal stamps, thin archival diagrams, faint measurement lines, and marginal annotations. The design should feel like a contemporary museum poster, editorial magazine spread, and historical archive board fused together.
Constraints: Preserve a clear exhibition-poster hierarchy despite the dense collage. Do not make it modern glossy; keep everything matte, aged, weathered, and printed on textured paper. Use no photorealistic people outside the mural fragments, no 3D effects, no bright neon colors, and no empty clean white background. The most prominent readable texts should be 「壁上乐舞」, {argument name="Chinese subtitle" default="敦煌壁画中的乐舞与文明"}, “DUNHUANG RHYTHMS”, and the date range {argument name="exhibition dates" default="2026 09.05 / 2027 01.16"}.
blocks.author: Larus Canus

blocks.title: No. 38: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Architectural Watercolor Sketch
blocks.description: A customizable architectural sketching prompt that combines ink linework with loose watercolor washes to create vibrant, atmospheric interiors.
blocks.prompt: Loose watercolor and pen sketch inside {argument name="location" default="[LOCATION / SUBJECT]"}, seen from {argument name="viewpoint" default="[VIEWPOINT]"} toward {argument name="focal point" default="[ARCHITECTURAL FOCAL POINT]"}, {argument name="central feature" default="[CENTRAL FEATURE]"} at center, {argument name="overhead structure" default="[OVERHEAD ARCHITECTURAL FEATURE]"} overhead. Ink line drawn first and left visible through every wash — {argument name="linework details" default="[ARCHITECTURAL LINEWORK]"} and {argument name="floor grid" default="[GROUND / FLOOR GRID]"} overshooting into blank paper, one long confident arc for {argument name="major curve" default="[MAJOR CURVE]"}. Wash about 65%, warm below and cool above: {argument name="warm palette" default="[WARM ARCHITECTURAL PALETTE]"} on {argument name="lower elements" default="[LOWER ARCHITECTURAL ELEMENTS]"}, {argument name="cool palette" default="[COOL PALETTE]"} over {argument name="upper feature" default="[UPPER ARCHITECTURAL FEATURE]"} thinning to bare line at the crown. Diagonal light shafts left as reserved white paper, the brightest value. Floor in {argument name="floor wash" default="[FLOOR COLOR / WASH]"} with a backrun. Figures in three depth bands, clustered and gapped, never in a row: {argument name="near figures" default="[NEAR FIGURES AND SCALE]"}, one cropped by the bottom edge; {argument name="mid figures" default="[MID FIGURES AND SCALE]"} scattered at different distances, {argument name="midground cluster" default="[MIDGROUND CLUSTER]"} clustered at {argument name="focal point" default="[FOCAL POINT]"}; {argument name="far figures" default="[FAR FIGURES AND SCALE]"} dissolving into strokes. Different actions each — {argument name="action 1" default="[ACTION 1]"}, {argument name="action 2" default="[ACTION 2]"}, {argument name="action 3" default="[ACTION 3]"}

blocks.title: No. 42: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Abstract Topographic Energy Map
blocks.description: Generates a refined abstract cartographic artwork with layered terrain textures, contour lines, dotted paths, and a glowing central convergence point.
blocks.prompt: Create an abstract topographic mixed-media artwork on a horizontal {argument name="aspect ratio" default="4:3 landscape"} canvas, resembling a large aerial geological map or energetic convergence diagram. The composition centers on a bright glowing circular hub slightly below the middle, made of concentric translucent rings in warm gold, cream, and gray, with thin radial lines extending outward. From this center, four broad organic terrain-like regions flow outward: a dark charcoal and slate-black river-shaped mass sweeping from the left edge into the center and down toward the lower left, a rusty burnt-orange and sienna canyon-like band expanding from the center to the lower right, a pale cream and sand-colored open field filling the upper and right areas, and muted gray-beige layered landforms in the upper left and lower middle. Cover the image with delicate contour lines, hairline curves, dotted paths, small node circles, and fine white and black route-like lines that weave across the colored regions. Include exactly 3 small orange dots near the upper center, exactly 2 large ochre circular stains in the upper right, and numerous tiny scattered black, white, gray, and gold dots arranged like constellations and map markers. Use a restrained palette of {argument name="main palette" default="ivory, charcoal black, warm gray, ochre gold, burnt orange, rust brown"}, with watercolor washes, mineral textures, translucent paper layers, ink scratches, stippling, and subtle grain. The style should feel like an elegant abstract cartographic painting, a cosmic topography, or a geological energy map, with no readable text, no labels, no border, no people, and no recognizable objects. Lighting should be soft and diffuse, with the central hub as the brightest point, creating a sense of motion and convergence. Render highly detailed fine linework and tactile handmade textures, suitable for a gallery-quality generative art print.
blocks.author: Anders Hjemdahl

blocks.title: No. 43: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Celica Real vs Miniature Comparison
blocks.description: Generates a three-panel photorealistic comparison of a white Toyota Celica GT-Four as a real car, a miniature-looking real car, and a realistic plastic model.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical comparison image showing the same white Toyota Celica GT-Four in three stacked photographic panels, comparing three realism styles: a real car, a real car photographed to look like a miniature, and a plastic model photographed to look like a real car.
Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, 768 × 1024 style, divided into exactly 3 equal horizontal panels separated by thin white divider lines. No captions or overlay text outside the car details.
Subject: A {argument name="car model" default="white Toyota Celica GT-Four ST205"} shown from a front-left three-quarter angle, low stance, white multi-spoke wheels, large rear wing, hood vent, round twin headlamps, front bumper fog lights, side decal reading “GT-FOUR,” and a Japanese license plate with the visible number {argument name="license plate number" default="22-31"}. The car should remain visually consistent across all three panels.
Setting: Nighttime urban industrial road scene in {argument name="location style" default="Japan"}, wet asphalt after rain, reflective puddles, concrete pillars, chain-link fencing, bridge or elevated roadway structures, and warm streetlights receding into the background with bokeh.
Panel 1: Top panel shows the real full-size car photographed naturally. Sharp, realistic automotive photography, crisp body details, accurate proportions, deep reflections on wet pavement, moderate background blur, cinematic night lighting.
Panel 2: Middle panel shows the same real car but photographed to look miniature. Use tilt-shift depth of field, stronger blur at foreground and background, slightly toy-like scale illusion, softened details, shiny wet road reflections, and a more diorama-like feel while still using the same viewpoint.
Panel 3: Bottom panel shows a plastic scale model of the same car photographed to look like a real full-size car. Keep the car highly realistic but subtly model-like in the surface finish and fine details; use shallow depth of field, realistic reflections, convincing low-angle automotive composition, and the same wet night street environment.
Visual style: High-quality photorealistic comparison, cinematic contrast, glossy white paint, warm orange and cool blue night tones, realistic lens bokeh, no people, no extra vehicles, no logos or watermarks. Maintain exactly 3 panels and exactly 1 car per panel.
blocks.author: のうめん🏗️👺生成AIパスポート認定取れた

blocks.title: No. 44: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - X-Ray Transparent Grand Piano
blocks.description: Generates a photorealistic black-background X-ray view of a grand piano with its internal strings, frame, action, legs, and hardware visible.
blocks.prompt: Create a highly detailed photorealistic X-ray image of a transparent grand piano, shown in clean side profile on a pure black background. The piano should look like it is made of glowing translucent glass and pale blue-white radiographic material, revealing all internal mechanisms: the harp-shaped frame, dense parallel strings, soundboard ribs, cross braces, tuning pin area, keyboard action, hammers, dampers, pedal rods, and structural supports. Show exactly 3 visible legs: one front left leg under the keyboard, one central support/pedal assembly area with thin vertical rods, and one rear right leg under the body. Include exactly 6 large circular sound holes along the upper curved rim of the piano frame. Make the outer casing thick and transparent with bright illuminated edges, fine screws and hardware visible, and layered internal components overlapping like a medical scan. Use crisp high-contrast lighting, luminous cyan-white highlights, subtle bloom, sharp technical detail, and no text, no people, no watermark. Center the object vertically and horizontally, with the full piano visible and cropped only by the image frame margins. The overall effect should be a futuristic museum-quality X-ray scan of a {argument name="object" default="grand piano"}, combining engineering cutaway precision with dramatic black-background radiography.
blocks.author: Ilyas Salaoui

blocks.title: No. 45: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Dark UI Character Sheet Evaluation
blocks.description: Generates a Japanese dark-mode comparison dashboard for evaluating character-sheet creation routes from a reference image.
blocks.prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the source material, create a dark-mode Japanese evaluation report slide that compares attempts to generate a character sheet while preserving the same rough watercolor/ink illustration style.
Goal: Turn the reference into a structured experiment-summary dashboard titled 「M2　ステップ2—ムードボードを見本に GPT でキャラクターシート」. Keep the subject as the small armored child character from the reference, but present the result as an analysis screen rather than a single illustration.
Canvas and style: Use a wide 16:9 dark UI layout with charcoal background, thin dividers, rounded cards, small Japanese UI text, orange/green accent labels, and embedded white image panels. Make it look like a screenshot of an internal comparison report.
Top section: Create exactly 3 comparison cards across the top. Each card contains a white character-sheet panel showing the same character in multiple views and a small detached head/bust crop. Use these card titles and edge scores:
1. 「経路A：GPT ムードボード経由」 with 「エッジ 57.6」
2. 「経路B：grok ムードボード経由」 with 「エッジ 52.6」
3. 「参考：grok キャラ直接（B-5）」 with 「エッジ 48.8」
Under each card add one short Japanese note line; the third card should mention that it is the softest and inherits the sample’s green cloth.
Middle section: Add a comparison table with exactly 4 columns labeled 「条件」, 「エッジ強度」, 「コントラスト」, 「見本の欠陥」. Include exactly 7 data rows:
1. 「grok（目標）」 — 47.2 — 82.4 — 「—」
2. 「1) 共通のみ」 — 53.6 — 90.8 — 「—」
3. 「2) + 筆致（言葉）」 — 52.0 — 88.4 — 「なし」
4. 「3) + grok キャラ見本」 — 「48.8 ← 最良」 — 85.4 — 「緑の布を継承」
5. 「4) + GPT ムードボード」 — 「57.6 ← 最悪」 — 84.5 — 「なし」
6. 「5) + grok ムードボード」 — 52.6 — 87.3 — 「なし」
7. 「素材 image3.png（参考）」 — 58.8 — 69.1 — 「—」
Bottom section: Add several short Japanese conclusion lines beginning with 「結論1」 through 「結論5」, explaining that moodboard routes are not very effective, direct character reference works better, and the practical workaround is to avoid moodboards and use the Grok output with cropping. Finish with a collapsible dark bar labeled 「プロンプト（ステップ2の冒頭：ムードボードの役割指定）」.
Constraints: Preserve the character identity and rough painted look from REFERENCE_0 in the embedded panels, but do not recreate the full original reference screenshot. Do not add unrelated characters. Use crisp UI typography and readable Japanese labels. The main title topic may be customized as {argument name="report title" default="M2　ステップ2—ムードボードを見本に GPT でキャラクターシート"}; the three route labels may be customized as {argument name="route labels" default="経路A：GPT ムードボード経由 / 経路B：grok ムードボード経由 / 参考：grok キャラ直接（B-5）"}; the character-sheet subject may be customized as {argument name="character subject" default="the small armored child knight from the reference"}; the table metric emphasis may be customized as {argument name="best and worst edge notes" default="48.8 ← 最良, 57.6 ← 最悪"}.

blocks.title: No. 69: 漫画 / 故事板 - Cybernetic Armor Suit Anime Sheet
blocks.description: A comprehensive system prompt for generating a high-quality 2D anime three-view character sheet of a woman in crimson cybernetic armor, based on a reference image.
blocks.prompt:
# Image Generation Instruction Sheet
[Input] Sheet Type: [{argument name="sheet type" default="design focused"} / simple]
If not entered, it defaults to [design focused].
[Purpose] Use only one full-body female image attached with this instruction sheet as the sole character reference to create one high-quality 2D anime three-view sheet dressed in a fixed armor suit. Photorealistic figures should be converted to 2D anime while maintaining character identity; if the original image is anime, maintain that character design and anime expression. Do not mix design-focused and simple styles; generate only the input sheet type.
[Strictly Fixed] Aspect ratio 1:1 square. Background is a thin neutral gray close to white. The three figures—FRONT/SIDE/BACK—are the same person in the same armor. Maintain facial features, eyes, nose, mouth, outline, age appearance, skin color, hairstyle, hair color, hair length, bangs, part, height feel, shoulder width, waist position, torso-to-leg ratio, leg length, overall ratio, body type, and head-to-body ratio; do not redesign except for the costume change. Creating a different person, excessive beautification, making the face smaller, making legs longer, slimming, increasing muscle, or changing head-to-body ratio is prohibited.
[2D Anime Expression] For photorealistic inputs, convert the entire character, including face, hair, skin, hands, armor, and legs, into a unified high-quality Japanese 2D anime expression. The face must be a clear 2D anime face; do not use photorealistic skin, pore texture, sculptural 3D shading, or make it look like a figure or doll. Hair should have organized anime-like bundles; shading should be cel-based with modest gradients. Maintain the metallic feel and luster of the armor, but do not make it photorealistic, 3DCG, or PBR rendered. If the source image is anime, do not change to a different art style; maintain the original face, hair, body type, and drawing tendencies.
[Fixed Armor Suit] A streamlined female cybernetic exoskeleton that fits naturally without deforming the original body type and is not bulky. Not a cloth bodysuit or a heavy military powered suit. Main color: {argument name="main color" default="deep glossy crimson red"}, secondary color: {argument name="sub color" default="pearl white to silver"}, internal structure: black/gunmetal. Unified with a three-layer structure of red hard armor surfaces, silver-white skeletal parts, and black internal mechanisms. The head maintains the original person's face and hair; helmets, full masks, red eye visors, and one-eyed mechanization are prohibited. The neck is a black and silver mechanical high neck. The chest has rounded red hard armor independent on the left and right, a silver-white vertical structure in the center, and silver rib-like plates and black internal mechanisms from below the chest to the sides. The center of the abdomen is a vertical red armor panel surrounded by black and silver mechanical frames, with silver-white armor and black connection structures visible at the waist, pelvis, and hip joints. Shoulders have red shoulder armor; upper and lower arms have red streamlined armor; elbows and connection points are black-silver internal mechanisms. Hands are thin 5-fingered mechanical hands. Thighs to shins are red streamlined armor with silver-white and black structures on the inside and around joints; knees are circular mechanical joints. Feet are mechanical high heels continuous from the leg armor. Simple all-red, cloth suit conversion, alternative costumes, or excessive glowing is prohibited.
[Three-View Continuity] FRONT/SIDE/BACK must represent the same armor viewed from different directions. The armor, joints, and color coding of the chest, sides, spine area, shoulders, arms, pelvis, thighs, knees, shins, and heels must naturally connect in three views according to the 3D structure. Do not redesign for each view.
[Pose] FRONT = Straight front. Face, shoulders, waist, and toes facing forward, arms down naturally. SIDE = Complete 90-degree true side. Do not turn the face toward the camera or pose at an angle. BACK = Complete rear view. No looking back. All three must include the full body from the top of the head to the toes; folding arms, crossing legs, hands in pockets, weapons, or action poses are prohibited.
[Design Focused] Divide the square into a large main area on the left (approx. 60%) and a vertical sub-area on the right (approx. 40%). A large FRONT view on the left; the right side is split into top and bottom halves with 02 SIDE on top and 03 BACK on bottom. The two right panels are of equal width and nearly equal height, organized as one vertical block with thin black borders. SIDE and BACK should be at a similar scale, aligned with consistent margins above the head and below the feet in each panel, avoiding meaningless large gaps. The chest has a large dark rectangular armor cover with white Japanese police text and “MPD” beneath it. The robot has a compact sensor head with multiple camera lenses and red-tinted optics, broad shoulders, bulky arms, mechanical hands, thick armored thighs, and complex open-frame lower legs.

Use a vertical 4:5 composition, eye-level to slightly low angle, with the robot centered and filling most of the frame from feet to head. blocks.title: No. 114: 电商主图 - Vitamin C Serum Beauty Ad
blocks.description: Creates a luxurious two-panel skincare advertisement featuring a glowing model, amber Vitamin C serum, and fresh oranges for beauty product marketing.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-end cinematic luxury skincare advertisement for {argument name="product name" default="Vitamin C Serum"}, focused on radiant skin, golden-orange serum, and fresh oranges.
Canvas: Vertical 3:4 image, split into exactly 2 horizontal panels separated by a thin white divider line. Warm golden-hour sunlight, shallow depth of field, glossy reflective surfaces, premium beauty-ad photography.
Subject details: A beautiful young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long dark brown hair"}, natural glowing skin, soft elegant facial features, thick brows, minimal warm makeup, small stud earrings, a delicate necklace, and a gentle confident smile. She wears a simple white camisole. Her expression is calm, fresh, and natural, looking toward the camera.
Top panel: Close-up beauty shot of the woman holding a glass dropper with a metallic gold cap near her cheek. A single golden-orange serum droplet is visibly hanging from the pipette and gliding onto her skin. Place one amber glass skincare bottle on the right foreground with a gold label reading “VITAMIN C SERUM” and smaller text “BRIGHTENING & GLOW BOOSTING” plus “30ml e 1.01 fl.oz.” Include exactly 2 visible orange elements in this panel: 1 large cut orange half in the lower-left foreground and 1 whole/partial orange behind the bottle on the right. Background: softly blurred sunlit window, beige curtains, indoor greenery.
Bottom panel: Show the same woman gently massaging serum into her right cheek with her fingertips, maintaining a soft confident smile and radiant hydrated skin. Place one amber dropper bottle on a small clear glass pedestal at the left foreground, with the white dropper top visible and the same gold “VITAMIN C SERUM” label. Include exactly 5 visible orange elements in this panel: 1 whole orange on the far left, 1 cut orange half/slice at the lower left, 1 orange wedge near the center foreground, 1 large cut orange slice in the lower-right foreground, and 1 whole/partial orange on the far right. Add a few green leaves around the oranges and warm bokeh highlights in the background.
Visual style: Ultra-realistic commercial beauty photography, luxurious amber and citrus color palette, warm sunlight, natural skin texture, dewy highlights, realistic serum gloss, polished reflections, soft cinematic focus, premium skincare advertising composition.
Constraints: Use exactly 2 stacked panels, exactly 2 product bottle appearances, exactly 1 visible serum droplet in the top panel, and no extra text beyond the product label.

blocks.title: No. 117: 电商主图 - Traditional Stewed Pear Dessert Poster
blocks.description: A detailed macro photography prompt for a Chinese-style dessert poster featuring snow pears in a glass pot with warm morning light and elegant typography.
blocks.prompt: A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of translucent snow pear from a stewing pot, with clear syrup forming a small backflow along the tip of the spoon. Design a 3:4 vertical rock sugar stewed pear poster for an original nourishing dessert brand "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}". The scene is set exclusively on a warm white stone window sill on an autumn morning. A 15cm diameter transparent heat-resistant glass stewing pot is placed slightly to the right of the center, with the glass lid lying flat to the back left. The pot is 70% full of clear light-gold syrup, precisely containing eight pieces of cut snow pear, six pieces of transparent rock sugar, and three dried osmanthus flowers. A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of pear from the right, stopping about 4cm above the rim of the pot, with the syrup backflow controlled at 3cm. The center of the pot is at 62% horizontal and 64% vertical, occupying about 38% of the frame width. The area from 7% to 42% horizontal and 9% to 47% vertical on the left remains a warm white text zone. The foreground contains only half a fresh snow pear with the cut side facing up, while the background features a soft white sheer curtain; do not add red dates, wolfberries, or tremella. The camera is 12cm above the middle of the pot, using a 90mm macro lens shooting from the front left at a 14-degree angle from a distance of 72cm. The focus is locked on the pear fibers in the spoon, the transparency of the syrup, and the edge of the glass pot, with the lid remaining recognizable. A large window-shaped soft light of about 5500K from the back left penetrates the syrup and pear meat, while a warm white reflector at the front right restores the glass contours. Two strands of very faint steam rise towards the window. The color scheme is 52% warm white background, 18% transparent light-gold syrup, 20% pear milk white, 5% glass gray, and 5% dark brown text. Pear meat should be soft and slightly translucent but retain its chunk shape; syrup should be clear and low-viscosity, not a thick jam or milky soup. Text is limited to brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}", product name "{argument name="product name" default="Rock Sugar Stewed Pear"}", main copy "{argument name="main copy" default="Pear fragrance stewed slowly, sweetness falls clearly"}", and English sub-title "ROCK SUGAR STEWED PEAR". The main text on the left uses a dark brown fine Song font in three lines, brand name at the top, product name and English at bottom left. Lock one pot, one lid, eight pear chunks, six rock sugar pieces, three osmanthus flowers, one glass spoon, and back-left window light; do not add herbs, a second pot, excessive condensation, thick steam, or floating pear chunks.

blocks.title: No. 118: 电商主图 - Mesh Top and Checkered Skirt Outfit
blocks.description: A highly technical fashion generation prompt for a classical girlie look, detailing the fabric textures, seams, and construction of a mesh knit crop top and a checkered A-line mini skirt.
blocks.prompt: Wardrobe: Top: One solid muted cocoa-taupe sleeveless mock-neck crop top made from a fine-gauge stretch mesh knit with tightly regular micro-openings, a lightweight semi-sheer section, a smooth low-luster face, soft close drape, and resilient multidirectional recovery. Cut a close straight-to-lightly-tapered body ending at the upper waist, with matching front and rear lower-edge levels and minimal bulk. Form a narrow circular self-fabric mock neck whose finished height is between one-tenth and one-sixth of the shoulder-to-hem length, using a double-layer return and one low-bulk rear join. Continue two narrow shoulder sections into high-cut sleeveless armholes and uninterrupted front and rear body panels. Finish both armhole circuits with narrow self-fabric turned bindings less than one-tenth of the shoulder-section width, join the body through two clean side seams, and complete the lower circumference with one narrow straight double-turn hem. Use the knit recovery and complete neck opening for a pull-on construction without exterior fastening. Keep the mesh scale evenly legible, the semi-sheer density consistent, the mock neck softly upright, the armhole edges flat, and the lower hem free of heavy opaque bulk. Bottom: One camel-tan wrap-front mini skirt made from medium-weight brushed twill with a compact diagonal weave, a short soft nap, a matte low-luster surface, firm shape retention, and rounded low-bulk folds; confine espresso brown, ivory, and muted dusty-rose to the woven geometric check and matte black to two front buttons. Cut a high-rise upper-thigh mini length with a close waist and upper hip, then widen gently into a compact A-line hem whose laid-flat width is between one-and-one-fifth and one-and-two-fifths of the top-edge width. Form a clean curved faced upper edge without a separate exterior waistband. Build smooth front and rear bodies with two equal rear waist darts, one at product-right and one at product-left, two side seams, and one full-height product-left front overlap panel spanning between one-half and two-thirds of the front width; keep its vertical free edge straight from the top edge to the hem and its underlap continuous behind it. Cover every front, overlap, side, and rear panel with a woven repeat of large upright camel rectangles bounded by single espresso lines and paired ivory lines, then add one fine dusty-rose pinstripe only to alternating vertical and horizontal corridors so the rose intersections shift by one cell on every second row; each complete repeat spans between one-quarter and one-third of the laid-flat front width, with straight orthogonal lines and clean registration across darts, seams, and the overlap. Mount two circular matte-black four-hole buttons in one vertical product-left-front line, each between one-tenth and one-eighth of the waist-to-hem depth in diameter; place the upper station within the upper quarter of that depth and the lower station between one-half and two-thirds of the depth. Secure the overlap through two matching reinforced buttonholes on the underlap, keeping both stations fully engaged and the panel flat, and finish the complete lower edge with one narrow turned hem. Preserve the short brushed nap, readable diagonal weave, crisp A-line outline, stable overlap depth, aligned geometric repeat, flat button seating, and material-correct hem thickness. Footwear: One matching pair of predominantly black combat boots built from medium-thick semi-matte coated leather-like upper material with a fine shallow grain and broad flexible crease response, black flat woven cord, silver-tone metal, and deep black molded rubber. Each boot is knee-high with a tall straight shaft, a broad rounded toe, a substantial forefoot platform, and a slightly deeper rear block, with shaft volume remaining open and stable near the top before compressing into broad slouch folds through the lower shaft and ankle. A wide straight topline forms the shaft opening and retains a clean finished edge. The upper consists of tall side and rear shaft panels joined to a rounded forefoot, broad vamp, quarters, and a central tongue; the vamp stays close while the shaft carries relaxed vertical volume. Paired rows of black lace holes run from the forefoot into the lower shaft and hold flat black laces, while two separate narrow wrap straps encircle each boot, one near the upper shaft and one at the ankle, each ending at its own compact rectangular silver-tone buckle. Tonal topstitching defines the panel joins, and the sole forms a thick continuous sidewall above a deeply cut lugged contact face. The laces close in compact tied bows and both buckle straps remain fastened through their rectangular frames. Both boots are identical anatomical mirror counterparts with the same panel layout, lace path, strap count, buckle placement, shaft height, slouch distribution, toe shape, and sole stack. Preserve the coated fine grain through the broad folds, keep the two buckle circuits physically separate from the lace closure, and maintain crisp sole edges, deep lug relief, firm toe volume, and material-correct seam bulk. Bag: Styling — highest priority: - Bag carry: Hang the strap from the wearer-right shoulder only without crossing the chest, and let the bag body lie flat along the right flank between the lower ribs and outer hip. Let the strap bear the full weight and keep both hands off the bag and strap. Keep the complete strap and bag body entirely outside and visibly separate from every garment, routing the strap over, never beneath or through, the outermost clothing. Do not pass it through any neckline, sleeve, knit opening, seam, or rear panel, and do not merge, attach, weave, replace, or reinterpret any bag material as part of a garment. - Finish — Natural: Adjust only material-correct slack and body contact along the exact selected strap route. Keep the selected route and all attachment points exact while allowing limited material-correct slack and natural body contact. One warm-ivory soft gathered chain-strap pouch bag made from lightweight lightly padded matte woven fabric, constructed as one medium rounded crescent-like body with softly tapered upper corners, a broad curved lower edge, shallow expandable side depth, and controlled flexible volume. Gather the complete upper body into one reinforced top-edge opening, producing repeated soft vertical folds that release through the front, rear, and side surfaces without rigid quilting lines. Add one long warm-gold-tone curb-chain strap attached through two small polished gold-tone D-rings and reinforced matching fabric tabs at the upper sides, preserving identical attachment height and hardware construction on both ends. Complete the front, rear, side panels, curved base, gathered upper edge, reinforced top opening, chain strap, D-rings, attachment tabs, hidden seam allowances, and internal soft support as one coherent bag with no visible exterior closure hardware, exterior pocket, readable branding, detachable charm, keychain, plush ornament, mascot, or additional decoration. Preserve lightweight textile response, softly padded body volume, even gather distribution, clean upper-edge reinforcement, secure chain anchoring, low seam bulk, and restrained warm-gold reflections. Necklace: One short silver fine-chain necklace built as one continuous closed circuit with a shallow curved ornament centered on one product axis. Keep most of the circuit as a slender uniform chain and confine the ornament to a short lower arc substantially shorter than the complete chain path. Construct the ornament from a closely spaced row of uniform short rounded cylindrical beads aligned radially to form a gentle crescent, connecting both ornament terminals directly into compact polished chain links. blocks.title: No. 34: 社交媒体帖子 - Strawberry Ice Cream Portrait
blocks.description: A detailed photorealistic prompt for a young woman at an ice cream shop, focusing on facial expressions, soft knit textures, and warm café lighting.
blocks.prompt:
Subject:
Strawberry ice cream pit stop
Main:
A single {argument name="person" default="young adult woman"} holding a cone of {argument name="ice cream type" default="strawberry ice cream"} at a round wooden table in an ice cream shop with warm lighting. Position the subject largely from the center to the left of the screen, with the face, hands, and ice cream as the close-up protagonists, leaving a showcase on the right.
Character/Expression:
Small rounded oval face, bright smooth skin, large dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, small nose, pale pink lips. The face is tilted to the bottom right of the screen, with a playful expression looking at the camera only with the eyes while extending the tip of the tongue toward the ice cream. Thin brown eyeliner and long eyelashes, natural glossy makeup. Dark brown short bob nearly black reaching the chin, parted on the right with thin bangs falling over the forehead and eyes, ends moving randomly inside and out.
Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="An ivory thin-strap camisole top"} with fine lace and a small ribbon at the chest, covered by a deep reddish-brown rib-knit cardigan loosely dropped from the shoulders. Leaning forward toward the table, holding a waffle cone vertically with the right hand. Fingers wrapped together, left arm off-screen. The ice cream is a single white scoop mixed with streaks of red strawberry sauce.
Background/Light:
A black-framed glass refrigerated showcase and bright shelves on the right, a wood-grain counter and blurred figures of customers in the back, and a dark wood-grain round table in the lower foreground. Warm interior lighting softly illuminates the face, shoulders, and hands from the upper left and front, with small lights in the background creating round bokeh. Skin shadows are shallow and smooth.
Composition/Camera:
3:4 aspect ratio. Near eye-level camera across the table, a close-range upper-body portrait viewed from slightly above. The top of the head is near the upper edge, the right elbow and torso are cut off at the edge, the face is centered in the upper half, and the ice cream and right hand are prominently placed in the lower center. Precisely focused on the face and ice cream, with the shop background heavily blurred by a shallow depth of field.
Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic live-action photo taken under warm indoor light. Realistically depicts the natural texture of skin, fine strands of hair, knit stitches, camisole lace, fingertips, waffle cone grid, and the cold texture of slightly melting ice cream. Based on amber and reddish-brown tones, avoiding excessive skin-smoothing or illustrative styles.
Negative:
Alterations to facial features, short bob, or the positional relationship between tongue and ice cream

Right panel: a more cinematic but less natural portrait of an elderly East Asian craftsman seated at a workbench in a woodworking studio, balding gray hair, deeply wrinkled face, dark shirt, carving a small wooden figure with hand tools, strong dramatic sunlight from a window, many chisels and woodworking tools standing upright behind him, wood shavings scattered across the table, high contrast shadows, slightly artificial glossy look. Include exactly 1 small blue circular overlay icon near the center-left of the right panel, with a simple white symbol inside, resembling an interface marker. Overall style: realistic photographic comparison, left image more natural and detailed, right image more stylized and dramatic. No extra captions, no watermarks beyond the single blue overlay icon, no borders except the white page background.

blocks.title: No. 36: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Retro Geometric Future Culture Poster
blocks.description: A sophisticated prompt for generating high-contrast, flat retro-style posters with complex geometric layouts, sharp typography, and vintage ink textures.
blocks.prompt: Construct any {argument name="theme" default="future theme"} into a retro cultural poster with a {argument name="background color" default="black background"} and strong flattening: at first glance, you see a large-scale high-contrast title and a group of thematic graphics repeated along depth and misplaced layer by layer. Text and images together form an oppressive black-and-white geometric composition rather than independent information areas. Use a nearly pure black background to carry heavy warm white text, with small amounts of {argument name="accent color" default="dark red-brown or old gold"} used only for fine horizontal lines, explanatory text, and weak emphasis; let the big title occupy the main visual weight at the top, and the information is divided into several nested cards with black backgrounds and white borders, interspersed with thematic objects along diagonal or stepped paths, creating a spatial rhythm like printed layouts being continuously copied, ghosted, and misplaced. The subject of the future theme should be dismantled into repeatable outlines, borders, or stacked slices, sharing the same hard-edged ink logic with cards, titles, and thin lines, forming a relationship where text and images block, intersperse, and nest within each other. The typeface adopts a high-contrast, narrow, and sculpted structure: heavy stems, obvious thickness contrast between horizontal and vertical strokes, sharp or slightly irregular corners at the endpoints, hard turns, and narrow internal cavities while maintaining long-distance recognition; no matter how the text system changes, it maintains tight character spacing, strong line spacing contrast, and a reading beat from large titles to small notes, making punctuation, accents, or other text marks obey the overall geometric axis. The image retains only a small amount of form that can support theme recognition, using layers of black, gray, and warm white and tough outlines, without adding soft gradients, commercial-grade polishing, or decorative details. Retain restrained traces of low-definition copying, slight misalignment, rough edges, local uneven inking, and old printing, but do not create serious damage out of thin air; the overall piece must look like a flat system completed by limited ink, repeating screens, and manual typesetting.

blocks.title: No. 37: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Beethoven Sonata DSD 256 Collage
blocks.description: A cinematic historical-to-futuristic music collage visualizing Beethoven's sonata performance transformed by modern DSD 256 audio.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic widescreen digital collage about Beethoven's Violin Sonata Op. 96 being rediscovered through modern high-resolution audio, blending a 19th-century Viennese salon performance with a futuristic DSD listening studio.
Canvas: 16:9 horizontal composition, dark dramatic chiaroscuro, ultra-detailed, painterly realism mixed with cybernetic audio visualization. The image should read left-to-right as a transformation from old classical performance to modern digital sound.
Layout: Split the scene into two connected halves with no hard border. Left half is a warm amber-brown historical oil-painting scene inside an ornate Viennese salon. Right half is a cool blue-black futuristic audiophile studio. A single horizontal audio waveform runs across the entire center of the image, starting as gold on the historical side and shifting into white, cyan, orange, magenta, and blue on the digital side.
Historical left side: Show exactly 2 main historical men in the foreground: 1 famous violinist in black formal 19th-century clothing playing a violin with a languid, tired expression, and 1 intense curly-haired Beethoven-like composer standing behind him, watching sternly. Add a small salon audience in the background, candlelit chandeliers, gilded walls, dark framed paintings, and aristocratic spectators. In the lower center-left foreground, include several large aged sheet-music pages with handwritten notation, tilted toward the viewer. Add a small monochrome ghostly orchestra scene in the lower-left corner as a memory-like vignette.
Modern right side: Show exactly 1 sleek black rectangular digital audio converter on a table, labeled "DSD 256" on its front panel, with a small round knob on the right. Place exactly 1 large black studio monitor speaker on the far right. Behind and around the device, create glowing cyan holographic equalizer bars, translucent circuit-like panels, soundwave diagrams, and floating fragments of musical notation. Below the device, show a vivid red-orange waveform falling downward like molten sound, merging into a glowing blue and magenta holographic architectural concert hall made of music staves and light.
Visual style: Hyper-detailed, moody, cinematic lighting, baroque oil-painting texture on the left, glossy high-tech cyber-audio rendering on the right, dense layered transparency, gold dust and smoky particles, deep blacks, amber candlelight, electric cyan and magenta neon. Make the transition feel emotional and profound, as if the true meaning of {argument name="musical work" default="Beethoven Violin Sonata Op. 96"} is revealed by {argument name="audio format" default="DSD 256"} in {argument name="recording year" default="2025"}.
Text constraints: The only readable device text should be "DSD 256". Do not add captions, titles, logos, watermarks, or extra typography.
blocks.author: Juan José Arango E.

blocks.title: No. 38: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Dunhuang Rhythms Exhibition Poster
blocks.description: Creates a dense archival museum poster blending Dunhuang mural fragments, Chinese calligraphy, exhibition details, and editorial collage typography.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a dense editorial cultural-exhibition poster about {argument name="exhibition title" default="Dunhuang Rhythms"}, combining Dunhuang mural fragments, music-and-dance archive typography, and layered museum ephemera.
Canvas: Tall vertical poster, approximately 2:3 ratio, aged warm beige rice-paper background with visible grain, stains, torn edges, faded ink, and pasted-collage seams. Overall mood is scholarly, archaeological, and highly designed, with intentional clutter but a strong grid.
Layout: Use an asymmetric high-density collage. On the far left, place four enormous stacked black Chinese calligraphy characters reading 「壁上乐舞」, occupying nearly the full height, distressed and ink-textured. Beside the large characters, add a narrow vertical Chinese subtitle reading 「敦煌壁画中的乐舞与文明」. At the top center-left, add a small bilingual series label: 「丝路映像 系列展」 with “Silk Road Imaging Series” underneath. At the top right, place the main English title in elegant serif capitals: “DUNHUANG RHYTHMS”, with the smaller subtitle “Fragments of Murals and Music” below.
Main imagery: Use exactly 6 visible mural/image fragments, all in faded Dunhuang cave-painting colors of turquoise, cinnabar red, ochre, black, and parchment beige: 1) a large upper-right flying apsara musician fragment with flowing ribbons crossing diagonally; 2) a lower-left torn fragment showing three mural musicians or dancers; 3) a mid-right small rectangular fragment of a standing dancer; 4) a mid-lower ornate floral scroll pattern fragment; 5) a large bottom-right close-up of a female bodhisattva or apsara face with jewelry and flowing ribbons; 6) a right-edge partial vertical mural strip cropped off the page. Make the fragments look like scanned ancient wall paintings with cracks, missing plaster, chipped edges, and uneven opacity.
Information blocks: Add many thin vertical Chinese text columns like museum notes and archival captions around the collage, especially along the far left margin, middle columns, and lower center. Include exactly 4 primary info panels: 1) a right-side date and venue panel with “2026 09.05 SAT / 2027 01.16 SUN”, Chinese venue text, and “Hexi Culture Center Shanghai”; 2) a lower-left educational panel listing “Instruments” and “Dance Poses” with a small line drawing of an instrument; 3) a bottom-left organizer/credits panel with Host, Co-operation, and Visual Design lines; 4) a lower-right cave caption panel reading “Cave 285, South Wall Music and Dance Scene (detail)” with Chinese above it.
Typography and style: Mix oversized rough black Chinese brush type, refined Western serif uppercase, small Chinese Song/Ming-style vertical text, and tiny English museum captions. Use black, dark brown, muted red stamp ink, and occasional faded grid marks. Add small red seal stamps, thin archival diagrams, faint measurement lines, and marginal annotations. The design should feel like a contemporary museum poster, editorial magazine spread, and historical archive board fused together.
Constraints: Preserve a clear exhibition-poster hierarchy despite the dense collage. Do not make it modern glossy; keep everything matte, aged, weathered, and printed on textured paper. Use no photorealistic people outside the mural fragments, no 3D effects, no bright neon colors, and no empty clean white background. The most prominent readable texts should be 「壁上乐舞」, {argument name="Chinese subtitle" default="敦煌壁画中的乐舞与文明"}, “DUNHUANG RHYTHMS”, and the date range {argument name="exhibition dates" default="2026 09.05 / 2027 01.16"}.
blocks.author: Larus Canus

blocks.description: A customizable architectural sketching prompt that combines ink linework with loose watercolor washes to create vibrant, atmospheric interiors.
blocks.prompt: Loose watercolor and pen sketch inside {argument name="location" default="[LOCATION / SUBJECT]"}, seen from {argument name="viewpoint" default="[VIEWPOINT]"} toward {argument name="focal point" default="[ARCHITECTURAL FOCAL POINT]"}, {argument name="central feature" default="[CENTRAL FEATURE]"} at center, {argument name="overhead structure" default="[OVERHEAD ARCHITECTURAL FEATURE]"} overhead. Ink line drawn first and left visible through every wash — {argument name="linework details" default="[ARCHITECTURAL LINEWORK]"} and {argument name="floor grid" default="[GROUND / FLOOR GRID]"} overshooting into blank paper, one long confident arc for {argument name="major curve" default="[MAJOR CURVE]"}. Diagonal light shafts left as reserved white paper, the brightest value. Floor in {argument name="floor wash" default="[FLOOR COLOR / WASH]"} with a backrun. Figures in three depth bands, clustered and gapped, never in a row: {argument name="near figures" default="[NEAR FIGURES AND SCALE]"}, one cropped by the bottom edge; {argument name="mid figures" default="[MID FIGURES AND SCALE]"} scattered at different distances, {argument name="midground cluster" default="[MIDGROUND CLUSTER]"} clustered at {argument name="focal point" default="[FOCAL POINT]"}; {argument name="far figures" default="[FAR FIGURES AND SCALE]"} dissolving into strokes. blocks.title: No. 43: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Abstract Topographic Energy Map
blocks.description: Generates a refined abstract cartographic artwork with layered terrain textures, contour lines, dotted paths, and a glowing central convergence point.
blocks.prompt: Create an abstract topographic mixed-media artwork on a horizontal {argument name="aspect ratio" default="4:3 landscape"} canvas, resembling a large aerial geological map or energetic convergence diagram. The composition centers on a bright glowing circular hub slightly below the middle, made of concentric translucent rings in warm gold, cream, and gray, with thin radial lines extending outward. From this center, four broad organic terrain-like regions flow outward: a dark charcoal and slate-black river-shaped mass sweeping from the left edge into the center and down toward the lower left, a rusty burnt-orange and sienna canyon-like band expanding from the center to the lower right, a pale cream and sand-colored open field filling the upper and right areas, and muted gray-beige layered landforms in the upper left and lower middle. Cover the image with delicate contour lines, hairline curves, dotted paths, small node circles, and fine white and black route-like lines that weave across the colored regions. Include exactly 3 small orange dots near the upper center, exactly 2 large ochre circular stains in the upper right, and numerous tiny scattered black, white, gray, and gold dots arranged like constellations and map markers. Use a restrained palette of {argument name="main palette" default="ivory, charcoal black, warm gray, ochre gold, burnt orange, rust brown"}, with watercolor washes, mineral textures, translucent paper layers, ink scratches, stippling, and subtle grain. The style should feel like an elegant abstract cartographic painting, a cosmic topography, or a geological energy map, with no readable text, no labels, no border, no people, and no recognizable objects. Lighting should be soft and diffuse, with the central hub as the brightest point, creating a sense of motion and convergence. Render highly detailed fine linework and tactile handmade textures, suitable for a gallery-quality generative art print.

blocks.title: No. 44: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Celica Real vs Miniature Comparison
blocks.description: Generates a three-panel photorealistic comparison of a white Toyota Celica GT-Four as a real car, a miniature-looking real car, and a realistic plastic model.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical comparison image showing the same white Toyota Celica GT-Four in three stacked photographic panels, comparing three realism styles: a real car, a real car photographed to look like a miniature, and a plastic model photographed to look like a real car.
Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, 768 × 1024 style, divided into exactly 3 equal horizontal panels separated by thin white divider lines. No captions or overlay text outside the car details.
Subject: A {argument name="car model" default="white Toyota Celica GT-Four ST205"} shown from a front-left three-quarter angle, low stance, white multi-spoke wheels, large rear wing, hood vent, round twin headlamps, front bumper fog lights, side decal reading “GT-FOUR,” and a Japanese license plate with the visible number {argument name="license plate number" default="22-31"}. The car should remain visually consistent across all three panels.
Setting: Nighttime urban industrial road scene in {argument name="location style" default="Japan"}, wet asphalt after rain, reflective puddles, concrete pillars, chain-link fencing, bridge or elevated roadway structures, and warm streetlights receding into the background with bokeh.
Panel 1: Top panel shows the real full-size car photographed naturally. Sharp, realistic automotive photography, crisp body details, accurate proportions, deep reflections on wet pavement, moderate background blur, cinematic night lighting.
Panel 2: Middle panel shows the same real car but photographed to look miniature. blocks.title: No. 45: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - X-Ray Transparent Grand Piano

Goal: Create a dark futuristic widescreen tech poster introducing {argument name="headline text" default="今日分享：5 个 GitHub 爆涨星技能"}, showing five fast-growing GitHub AI tools as large interface cards above a modern developer workstation.

blocks.title: No. 49: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Photography Tutorial and Camera Setup Infographic
blocks.description: An advanced prompt for generating instructional infographics for photography. It takes a reference image and breaks down the camera position, distance, height, and angle, providing a clear 'how-to' guide for recreating the shot.
blocks.prompt:
Using [{argument name="reference image" default="Image 1 Reference"}] as the sole visual basis, generate a vertical 3:4 {argument name="teaching topic" default="street photography knowledge analysis chart"} (educational infographic poster). Goal: Use clear and interesting diagrams to explain "subject position, camera position, lens/distance, camera height, shooting angle, and composition points" for the purpose of teaching others how to recreate the shot. Overall style: Clean and high-end photography tutorial infographic + light scrapbook-style annotations; light off-white paper texture or light gray background; mainly black, white, and gray; automatically extract 1–2 colors from Image 1 as accents; sharp lines, high information density but not cluttered, unified alignment, and strong readability.
Mandatory Rules:
- Must preserve the following from Image 1: subject pose, relative position between subject and environment, main background structural lines, lighting direction, and spatial logic.
- Do not change the pose or the scene; only provide an "analytical diagrammatic presentation."
- Faces are not the focus: they can be lightly blurred/simplified, no realistic beautification, no emphasis on facial features.
- Full Chinese; no English, no brand names, no watermarks, no UI interface elements.
Fixed Layout (remains the same every time, does not change with Image 1):
1) Main Visual Area (upper half or large image on the left): Place the "Reference Scene Display" (lightly stylized/illustrated based on Image 1, but with recognizable scene and posture), overlaid with: rule-of-thirds grid, subject outline box, leading line prompts, vertical/horizontal line correction prompts; use numbered dots + hand-drawn arrows to mark key points (subject landing point, negative space direction, leg extension direction, background leading line source).
2) Diagram Area (two side-by-side images on the right or bottom half):
- Top View: Use minimalist icons to draw wall/street/building boundaries (abstracted from Image 1), subject position (person icon), camera position (camera icon); must show shooting direction arrows, distance between subject and camera (dashed line + numerical range), recommended position points A/B (two alternative positions); camera orientation must match Image 1 (front/side/oblique, etc.).
- Side View: Draw ground line, subject height示意, camera height示意, tilt angle sector; must show camera height range from ground (reasonably inferred from Image 1), lens tilt angle range (reasonably inferred from Image 1); low angle/eye level/high angle must be correct.
3) Parameter Card Area (three fixed rounded-corner cards at the bottom):
- Card 1: Lens and Distance (give recommended equivalent focal length range + shooting distance range).
- Card 2: Camera Height and Angle (give camera height range + tilt angle range).
- Card 3: Pose and Body Points (summarize key points of the pose in Image 1 using short sentences).
4) Error Demonstration Area (fixed at the bottom right): 3 red-cross error prompts (automatically generated based on the most relevant issues in Image 1, short sentences), for example: don't use ultra-wide angle too close to the face, don't crop toes/fingers, don't use a camera position that's too high resulting in distorted proportions (adjust automatically based on Image 1's actual situation).
Automatic Inference Requirements (to make it usable for any replacement of Image 1):
- Automatically infer and write into the diagrams based on Image 1: camera orientation, camera height, shooting distance interval, equivalent focal length interval, subject landing point and cropping strategy, background leading line source.
- All numerical values should be expressed as "ranges" (credible and reproducible), do not provide a single fixed number.
Output Requirements:
High definition, sharp lines, natural shadows, unified icons, neat layout, readable information; no garbled text, no logos, no watermarks, no excessive decoration.
Negative Constraints:
No watermarks, no logos, no English, no garbled text, no overly realistic faces, no exaggerated cartoon proportions, no limb deformities/extra fingers, no cluttered layouts, no low resolution, no heavy filters, no changes to the subject pose or scene relationship of Image 1.

blocks.title: No. 50: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Lipstick Recommendation and Analysis Infographic
blocks.description: A comprehensive prompt that transforms the AI into a professional makeup consultant. It analyzes a user's selfie to provide a visual infographic report featuring skin tone analysis, specific color recommendations from high-end brands, and usage suggestions.
blocks.prompt:
You are a professional makeup consultant, image analyst, and infographic designer.
Please generate a "Lipstick Recommendation Report Infographic" based on the selfie uploaded by the user and the specified lipstick brand.
Objective:
Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades based on the person's overall temperament, skin tone tendency, makeup suitability, and lip characteristics, and present them in a clear, professional way that matches the brand's identity.
Brand:
{argument name="brand name" default="Dior / YSL / Armani / Chanel / Tom Ford"}
The visual content includes the following structures:
1. Top-left area: User selfie and basic analysis
- Display the user's selfie avatar
- Extract skin tone tendency, overall temperament, and suitable color directions
- Summarize with short Chinese labels, such as: cool-toned, soft, commuting, powerful, etc.
2. Middle main area: Lipstick recommendation matrix
- Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades
- Show the lip swatching effect for each shade
- Keep the same person, same angle, and same lighting, only changing the lip color
- Each shade is accompanied by a Chinese name or number
- Mark the color impression, such as: gentle bean paste, commuting nude red, temperament rose, brightening red-brown, date berry, etc.
3. Right or bottom area: Usage scenario suggestions
- Match suitable scenarios for each recommended shade
- For example: commuting, dating, shopping, banquet, photography, daily bare-faced look
4. Bottom summary area: Conclusion and suggestions
- Give summaries such as "most recommended color," "most versatile color," "best complexion-enhancing color"
- Write a short Chinese purchase or selection suggestion
Brand visual style should automatically match:
- Dior: Elegant French gray-white + silver accents
- YSL: High-contrast black-gold, sexy and strong
- Armani: Low-saturation gray tones, high-end and restrained
- Chanel: Minimalist black and white, rational and stylish
- Tom Ford: Dark luxury, cinematic feel
- Visual language can be extended automatically according to the brand
Visual Requirements:
- The overall look should resemble a high-end beauty consultant report or brand swatching analysis chart
- Chinese text must be clear and accurate
- Clean layout, complete information, suitable for social media sharing
- Keep the character identity consistent, only comparing lip color differences
- High-end style, avoid looking like common e-commerce screenshots
Note:
This is a visual recommendation based on image and temperament; do not make medical judgments or absolute conclusions.
blocks.author: Derek Wen｜德里克文

blocks.description: Generates a warm overhead anime-style illustration of a sleepy person napping on a sofa in a book-filled cozy room.
blocks.prompt: Create a warm, cozy hand-drawn anime illustration in a soft watercolor-and-ink style, viewed from a high overhead three-quarter angle inside a small reading room. Include exactly two tall bookcases, one on the left wall and one on the right wall, both filled with neatly arranged books; add two small wall shelves on the upper left with books, a potted plant, and a framed picture. Place a wooden desk and one simple wooden chair on the left side, with an open notebook or papers on the desk. On the floor in front of the sofa, include one woven rectangular rug with fringed edges, exactly one pair of socks lying near the sofa, one small closed book near the rug center, and one brown leather satchel bag to the right. Add one upholstered armchair at the lower right corner, partially cropped. blocks.title: No. 86: 漫画 / 故事板 - Quiet Hamster Manga Page
blocks.description: A structured prompt for generating a delicate grayscale Japanese manga page with a kimono-clad man gently addressing a small hamster in a traditional garden room.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a grayscale Japanese manga page about {argument name="character name" default="Hamster who suddenly came back"}, featuring a quiet traditional room, a tiny hamster, and a beautiful long-haired man in a kimono gently trying to coax it.
Canvas: Vertical manga page, portrait orientation, clean white margins, black panel borders, delicate pencil-and-ink shading, soft screentone gradients, high-detail shoujo manga style. Add a small handwritten-style Japanese title at the top left reading 「ひっくりかえったハムスター」 and a page number at the top right reading 「1/6」. Add a small footer centered at the bottom reading 「はむwithOpus4.6」.
Layout: Use exactly 5 panels arranged from top to bottom. Panel 1 is a wide establishing panel across the top, showing a traditional Japanese veranda and garden. Panel 2 row has two side-by-side panels: left wider panel with the man seen from behind sitting on the veranda facing the hamster; right narrower panel with a closer view of the man by the sliding door. Panel 3 is a wide horizontal close-up panel of the man speaking softly. Panel 4 is a final wide, low horizontal panel showing the hamster rolling over.
Panel details: Panel 1: an empty tatami-and-wood Japanese room opening onto a sunlit garden with hydrangeas, leafy trees, a bamboo fence, and a stone lantern. On the right, an open shoji doorway reveals shelves with books and stacked items inside. On the wooden veranda near the right side sits a small round hamster. Above it place a vertical ellipsis 「・・・・・・」. Dappled sunlight and leaf shadows fall across the floor.
Panel 2 left: the long-haired man sits with his back to the viewer on the veranda, wearing a loose dark haori over a pale kimono. He has very long pale hair braided down his back. The tiny hamster faces him from several feet away. The garden foliage fills the background. Panel 2 right: close portrait of the man standing or leaning by the shoji frame, one hand touching the sliding door. He has pale messy bangs partly covering tired, gentle eyes, a long side braid, a composed slightly melancholic expression, and elegant facial features. Add a vertical speech balloon with 「・・・・・・おや。」.
Panel 3: wide close-up of the man from chest up, angled slightly left, with soft white bokeh/snowlike dots in the background. His expression is kind, calm, and mildly concerned. Use exactly 2 vertical speech balloons: left balloon text 「話したくなくても、ここにいるよ。」 and right balloon text 「・・・・・・話したくなったら、ここにいるよ。」.
Panel 4: minimal pale background with floor line, showing the fluffy hamster lying on its side/back after rolling over, small motion lines near its body. It has round glossy black eyes, tiny ears, soft fur, and an adorably defeated expression. Add large vertical Japanese sound effect text 「ころん」 on the right.
Subject details: The male character should look like an ethereal adult bishounen with {argument name="hair color" default="very pale blond or white"} long messy hair, a thick braid over one shoulder or down his back, slim build, and wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a white kimono with a dark haori"}. The hamster should be {argument name="hamster appearance" default="a small round fluffy white hamster with black eyes"}.
Visual style: Fine monochrome manga line art, elegant shoujo proportions, delicate crosshatching, soft gray washes, detailed botanical background, peaceful atmosphere, subtle humor, readable Japanese lettering, no color.
Constraints: Use exactly 5 panels, exactly 1 hamster, exactly 1 human character, exactly 5 visible text elements inside the story panels: 「・・・・・・」, 「・・・・・・おや。」, 「話したくなくても、ここにいるよ。」, 「・・・・・・話したくなったら、ここにいるよ。」, and 「ころん」. Do not add extra characters, extra animals, modern objects, watermarks, or English dialogue.

blocks.title: No. 88: 漫画 / 故事板 - Commercial Storyboard Story Sheet
blocks.description: A comprehensive instruction for generating a professional 6-panel commercial storyboard sheet, complete with camera directions and visual descriptions.
blocks.prompt:
Create a premium professional 20-second commercial storyboard sheet in 3:4 landscape, designed like a real advertising-agency production storyboard.
- Exactly 6 panels, 2×3 grid
- Each panel = 3–4 seconds
- Dark deep-red header: NO. | VISUAL | ACTION / DIALOGUE
- Large cinematic visual area + narrow white information area
- White numbered circle in upper-left of every visual
- Thin black/gray borders, clean white background
- Sharp, highly legible text
- Photorealistic commercial photography
- No extra panels, title, or decorative elements
- One finished storyboard sheet only
STORY: “THE LAST 20 MINUTES”
A young Indonesian office worker rushes through the city after work, discovers a MIXUE outlet, takes a spontaneous five-minute break, and enjoys a Strawberry Mi-Shake.
RUSH → PAUSE → DISCOVERY → ORDER → CREATION → HAPPY RESET
PANEL 1 — 0–3s
CAMERA: Fast Tracking Shot, Handheld
ACTION: Indonesian woman, mid-20s, shoulder-length dark hair, white blouse, navy trousers, white sneakers and black laptop bag rushes through a busy sidewalk while checking her phone.
DIALOGUE: “Aduh, tinggal sebentar lagi.”
VISUAL: Busy Indonesian street, office workers, motorcycles, traffic and late-afternoon light with energetic motion.
PANEL 2 — 3–6s
CAMERA: Slowdown → Smooth Dolly In
ACTION: She notices a MIXUE strawberry drink poster, stops, smiles and decides to enter.
DIALOGUE: “Lima menit masih cukup.”
VISUAL: Motion-blurred city around her while she remains sharp. Bright red MIXUE storefront and strawberry drink visible through glass. Cinematic “world stops” effect.
PANEL 3 — 6–9s
CAMERA: Medium Shot, Smooth Counter Push-In
ACTION: She enters and orders from a cheerful young male cashier in a black MIXUE uniform and cap.
DIALOGUE:
Customer: “Kak, Strawberry Mi-Shake satu.”
Cashier: “Siap!”
VISUAL: Authentic Indonesian MIXUE interior, menu boards, POS counter and natural interaction.
PANEL 4 — 9–12s
CAMERA: Over-the-Counter Close-Up
ACTION: Cashier prepares the Strawberry Mi-Shake, pouring fresh strawberry mixture and creamy milk into a transparent branded cup.
DIALOGUE: “Fresh satu buat kakak.”
VISUAL: Premium preparation shot with red strawberry layer, creamy milk, realistic liquid movement, condensation and stainless-steel equipment.
PANEL 5 — 12–16s
CAMERA: Extreme Close-Up, Slow Motion Food Cinematography
ACTION: Creamy topping, strawberry pieces and glossy strawberry sauce are added.
DIALOGUE: —
VISUAL: Macro hero shot of strawberry sauce flowing over cream, fresh fruit, condensation, rich red-and-white contrast and shallow depth of field.
PANEL 6 — 16–20s
CAMERA: Hero Product Shot → Rack Focus
ACTION: Cashier hands her the drink. She takes a sip, relaxes, checks her phone, realizes she still has time and sits by the window.
DIALOGUE:
Customer: “Untung sempat.”
Cashier: “Enjoy, kak.”
VISUAL: Strawberry drink foreground, woman smiling in middle ground, busy city softly blurred

Keep the image disciplined and elegant so the crabs remain the warm visual core against the colder environment. Typography and layout: preserve the logic of a clean small brand-signature or photographer-signature zone near the bottom if needed, but use only fully original fictional text. Keep typography minimal and secondary. Do not copy any wording from the reference. The first is a slim translucent dishwashing liquid bottle showing luminous lemon-yellow liquid, a sleek neck, and a refined dark pump or closure detail. The second is a broader matte-white floor-cleaner bottle with a sculptural ergonomic silhouette, soft green closure area, and confident premium proportions. Both labels must be fully original, elegant, modern, and highly readable, using refined green, white, black, and soft yellow accents. No copied branding, no copied names, and no resemblance to existing real brands. Environment: set the scene in a complete spring garden-home world with a refined palette of sage green, misted pistachio, soft botanical green, fresh herb green, and creamy spring light. Increase the overall saturation moderately but elegantly, so the image feels richer, fresher, and more premium. Add soft natural sunlight, leafy shadows, small white blossoms, and a few curated leaves around the swing base. The setting should feel like an airy lifestyle space merging interior calm with botanical outdoor freshness. Lighting: use clean natural daylight from upper right-front, creating a premium spring atmosphere with brighter, richer greens and crisp but soft highlights on the bottle shoulders, labels, liquid body, removed cap, ropes, and swing plank. Let leaf-shaped shadows play elegantly across the wall and ground. The light must feel fresh, optimistic, breathable, and high-end. Material rendering: the yellow dish liquid must feel clear, glossy, and fresh, with realistic translucency and internal glow. The white cleaner bottle must feel matte-satin and premium, with soft edge reflections and precise industrial shape. The removed cap must feel tactile, molded, realistic, and intentionally placed. The wood swing seat must feel warm and naturally grained. The ropes must feel taut and fibrous. Leaves must feel semi-waxy and crisp. Blossoms must feel delicate and seasonal. Every material must obey immaculate commercial lighting and clean physical realism. Typography and layout: preserve the left-side advertising-copy layout as a major compositional feature. Add fully original premium English headline text in a graceful hand-lettered and modern sans-serif combination, for example: “Fresh Living Together” with a smaller supporting line beneath such as: “Beautiful care makes every corner bloom.” Add a small fictional brand mark in the top-left and a tiny campaign note in the top-right if needed. All wording must be fully original and never copied from the reference. Image quality and physical constraints: extreme detail, clean bottle silhouette, readable label design, coherent product shadows, believable swing suspension, elegant spacing, no muddy shadows, no black blotches, no cluttered props, no cheap plasticity, no low-resolution textures. The final result must feel like a world-class household-cleaning flagship campaign poster: product-led, fresh, elevated, memorable, and subtly anthropomorphic. blocks.title: No. 96: 产品营销 - Summer Soda Optical Illusion
blocks.description: A creative surreal prompt for an optical illusion where a blue soda glass and a woman's hand pop out of a cracked smartphone screen.
blocks.prompt:
Subject:
Summer soda crossing the screen
Main:
A photorealistic optical illusion piece where a woman's hand and a glass of {argument name="drink" default="blue soda"} three-dimensionally pop out from a {argument name="device" default="huge black-rimmed smartphone"} placed on a bright wooden table. From the top right, another hand tilts a transparent bottle, pouring a vigorous stream of water into a glass containing lemon. The smartphone screen radiates cracks centered at the base of the glass.
Character/Expression:
A portrait of a woman in her 20s inside the smartphone. Rounded oval face with a small chin, horizontal dark brown eyes, thin loose brows, small round nose tip, and glossy coral pink lips of natural thickness. Facing forward, looking at the camera, and smiling brightly to show white teeth. Thin brown eyeliner and peach cheeks. Dark brown hair tied high, with thin bangs, wisps of hair around the face, and blue-and-white frilled ornaments.
Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="character outfit" default="A puff-sleeved top layered with sheer white and pale blue fabric"}, fine ruffles around the shoulders, and a thin silver necklace. The subject's own right arm extends toward the foreground, firmly grasping a tall transparent glass. The glass contains bright blue carbonated water, ice, and thin lemon slices. Another adult's right hand at the top right holds a transparent bottle with water droplets horizontally, pouring water from the blue mouth.
Background/Light:
A pale wood-grain table, a transparent round wind chime containing blue-purple morning glories in the back left, a transparent saucer, and a strip of paper with a blue firework pattern in the front left. A white cloth with blue embroidery in the bottom right. The background inside the smartphone is a blue sky and white clouds. Strong summer diffused light enters from the window in the top left, creating white reflections on water droplets, ice, glass, and screen cracks.
Composition/Camera:
3:4 aspect ratio. A close-up overhead shot looking down diagonally at the table. The smartphone is placed diagonally from the bottom left to the top right, with the woman's face in the center right, the protruding glass in the center foreground, and the pouring bottle and hand at the top right edge. The lower part of the device is captured near the bottom left edge. Precisely focused on the glass, water stream, and face, with background items lightly blurred by a shallow depth of field.
Texture/Style:
A high-definition surreal advertising visual based on live-action photography. Realistically depicts wet transparent plastic, flowing water, carbonation bubbles, ice, glass, the cracked screen, skin, and wood grain, freshly emphasizing blue and white.
Negative:
Loss of the illusion where the glass and hand penetrate the screen.
